title: Mapping from a description: polystyrene, two beads per repeat unit
prompt: I want to coarse-grain polystyrene with two beads per repeat unit. Propose the mapping I can use with ascg. Only propose it; do not build or run anything.

checks.expr: r['ok'] and r['species'][0]['kind'] == 'repeat_unit' and r['species'][0]['beads_per_unit'] == 2 and sorted(len(b['heavy_atoms']) for b in r['species'][0]['beads']) == [2, 6]
